query:
SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email
        FROM "user" u
        WHERE u.is_active = TRUE
          AND u.is_verified = TRUE
          AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND u.id <> $1
          AND (
              u.id = $2
              OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1
                  FROM listing_staff ls
                  WHERE ls.listing_id = $3
                    AND ls.staff_user_id = u.id
                    AND 'staff'::user_role = ANY(u.roles)
              )
          )
        ORDER BY u.id
